From: Northgate Web Studio Ltd, 14 Fenchurch Street, London EC3M 3BD
VAT registration: GB 312 4567 89
Bill to: Larkspur Interiors Ltd
Invoice date: 25/08/2026    Due date: 24/09/2026    Terms: 30 days
Description: E-commerce build, milestone 1
Net total: £4,166.67
VAT @ 20%: £833.33
TOTAL DUE: £5,000.00
Payment: bank transfer to sort code 20-45-67, account 12345678, quoting INV-2250.

Barclays business current account export — sort code 20-45-67, account 12345678
Date,Type,Description,Money out,Money in,Currency
06/08/2026,FPI,"LARKSPUR INTERIORS DEPOSIT",,2000.00,GBP

From: james@larkspurinteriors.example
Date: 27/08/2026
Subject: Re: Invoice INV-2250

Thanks for the invoice. Please apply the £2,000.00 deposit we paid on 6 August (reference DEPOSIT) to INV-2250 as a part payment; we will pay the remaining £3,000.00 on the due date.

Work request: investigate whether the invoice identified in this packet has been settled as of the snapshot date. The request itself is not evidence that any payment occurred or that anyone owes a reply.
